summary: Expanded the universe around the less obvious restaurant equipment/service chokepoint. The strongest reference name is Middleby because it is directly tied to commercial restaurants, fast-food chains, beverage, refrigeration, ovens, fryers, ice, coffee and connected equipment. The underfollowed lane surfaces Farmer Bros. as a micro-cap speculative exception with unusually direct coffee/beverage equipment service exposure, Hudson Technologies as a refrigerant/reclamation and emergency refrigeration-service adjacency, and Watsco as a large but underappreciated HVAC/R and foodservice parts-distribution node through Baker Distributing. No buy/sell view is implied; this is a Layer 1B research universe expansion only.
